site.audience: retail traders, investors, and financial analysts seeking real-time market data and community insights

brief.title: ChartPulse — Track All Markets
brief.one_liner: A supercharged charting platform and social network for traders and investors to analyze, discuss, and trade global markets.
brief.goal: Provide a comprehensive financial dashboard where users can view real-time market data across asset classes, explore community trading ideas, use advanced charting tools, and find verified brokers.

pages.objective: Serve as the main landing page showcasing the platform's value proposition, live market summaries across asset classes, community-generated trading ideas, and top financial news stories.

Provide an interactive charting workspace with candlestick charts, drawing tools, technical indicators, a watchlist panel, and detailed stock information including earnings, dividends, and analyst ratings.
Display a community-driven feed of trading ideas and technical analysis posts with filtering by popularity, editor picks, and asset type.
Provide a comprehensive overview of all global markets organized by asset class with live prices, mini charts, earnings calendars, and IPO calendars.
Showcase verified broker listings with ratings, reviews, account counts, and promotional offers, allowing users to compare and select brokers.

interactions.trigger: Click on market summary tabs (US stocks, Crypto, Futures, Forex, Economy, Brokers)
interactions.expected: Content switches to display the selected market category data

interactions.trigger: Click on Editors' picks or Popular tab in community ideas section
interactions.expected: Idea cards update to show filtered content based on selected tab

interactions.trigger: Click on Editors' picks or Popular tab in indicators section
interactions.expected: Indicator listings update to show filtered content

interactions.trigger: Click on watchlist category headers (Indices, Stocks, Futures, Forex, Crypto)
interactions.expected: Category section expands or collapses to show/hide symbols in that group

interactions.trigger: Click on date range buttons (1D, 5D, 1M, 3M, 6M, YTD, 1Y, 5Y, All)
interactions.expected: Chart updates to display the selected time range

interactions.trigger: Click on tabs in stock detail panel (Income statement Annual/Quarterly)
interactions.expected: Financial data switches between annual and quarterly views

interactions.trigger: Click on Popular or Editors' picks tab
interactions.expected: Idea feed filters to show selected category of ideas
Feed filters to show only video-based trading ideas

interactions.trigger: Click on asset class tabs (Indices, US stocks, Crypto, Futures, Forex, Bonds, ETFs, Economy)
interactions.expected: Page scrolls to or displays the selected asset class section

interactions.trigger: Click on chart display options (1D, 1M, 3M, 1Y, 5Y, All, Area, Candles)
interactions.expected: Mini charts update to reflect selected timeframe and chart type

interactions.trigger: Click on Regular hours, Pre-market, or After-hours tab in stock gainers/losers
interactions.expected: List updates to show gainers/losers for the selected trading session

interactions.trigger: Click on broker category tabs (All brokers, Stocks, Crypto, Forex, Futures, ETFs, Options)
interactions.expected: Broker listings filter to show only brokers in the selected category

interactions.trigger: Click on Best rated or All brokers tab
interactions.expected: Broker listings reorder based on selected sorting criteria

data_display.description: Major market indices with current prices and percentage changes displayed as a summary bar
Cryptocurrency market overview showing total market cap, Bitcoin dominance, and top coin prices
Key commodity futures prices including oil, gold, and natural gas
Community trending stocks list showing ticker symbols, prices, and percentage changes
Watchlist sidebar showing symbols organized by category with last price, change, and percentage change columns
Detailed stock information panel showing current price, change, volume, market cap, and upcoming earnings
Key financial metrics including dividends, earnings, performance, technicals, and analyst ratings
Complete list of US market indices with prices and daily changes
Top US and world stocks with current prices, changes, and mini sparkline charts
Top stock gainers and losers showing company names with dramatic percentage changes
Major forex currency pairs with exchange rates and daily changes
Government bond yields across different maturities with yield curve visualization
Broker cards showing tier badges, ratings, review counts, account counts, and promotional offers
Platform-wide statistics banner showing total connected traders and executed orders
Upcoming and recent earnings reports showing company name, actual EPS, and estimated EPS
Corporate bond listings showing coupon rates, yield to maturity, and maturity dates
